send_intents.subject: AI platform engineering at SingleStore
send_intents.body:
Hi Pancham,

Your October hiring note about SingleStore's AI Platform caught my eye, particularly the work on agent runtimes, vector search, and making LLM systems reliable. I also noticed the Software Engineer opening for India on your careers page.

I'm an India-based engineer who has shipped backend APIs and AI workflows at Stride.AI. I built Captar to add execution budgets, tool policies, and tracing to LLM applications. I enjoy owning the engineering details from prototype to production.

Is the AI Platform team still considering engineers, or is the India Software Engineer role the better place to apply?

Portfolio: https://devansh.aurat.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/8dazo

Devansh
